search_window.basis: Since prior verified supplementary Care Line heartbeat completion; late discovery of a same-day acute access event that became reportable shortly before the prior check finished is explicitly labeled as a recall/backfill candidate, not a claim that its occurrence postdates this window.

findings.title: UPDATE: Lockdown lifted at Valley Children’s Hospital
findings.exact_supporting_passage: The hospital was not accepting patients arriving by car, ambulance, or helicopter.
findings.service_line: Hospital patient arrival/intake, including ambulance and helicopter transport; exact clinical units affected not specified
findings.access_consequences: Hospital temporarily declined patient arrivals by car, ground ambulance, and helicopter during a precautionary lockdown following a threat call. Local reporting says deputies gave the all-clear and lifted the lockdown after approximately 2.5 hours. Direct admission/ED routing details were not specified.
findings.affected_population: Patients seeking admission or urgent care at Valley Children's Hospital, including pediatric patients and medical transport arrivals; number affected unknown.

coverage_notes.scope: Supplementary recall coverage across U.S. states, DC and five inhabited territories; hospital, emergency, maternity, behavioral health, dialysis, oncology, primary care, rural services, EMS/air-medical access loss or restoration, and official CMS sanctions. Production national collector remains authoritative.

cms_public_notices.observation: Direct CMS Public Notices list inspected before all 12 targeted searches; newest entries dated 2026-10-30, no newer listed November 1 notice found.

targeted_queries: site:gov "November 1, 2026" hospital emergency room closure suspension United States
"November 1, 2026" Guam "Northern Mariana" "Puerto Rico" hospital clinic ambulance closed
coverage_notes.search_method: 12 targeted fast web searches with one-day recency, with direct source inspection for credible same-day local reporting; quality and concrete access effect screened.
coverage_notes.finding_timing_caveat: FOX26 article was first published 2026-11-01 and updated 4:37 p.m. as displayed, before the prior watch's 4:48:42 p.m. completion. This is a newly detected same-day recall/backfill candidate missed by the previous heartbeat, not evidence that the lockdown began or ended after 4:48 p.m.; production dedupe/ingestion not independently confirmed. Review must verify it is absent from production before accepting.

coverage_notes.search_quality: DEGRADED: Web recency search predominantly returned old, unrelated, international, or future-plan stories. The same-day Valley Children's acute patient-intake interruption was verifiable through local reporting, but rural and territorial negative-coverage confidence remains limited.
coverage_notes.limitations: Source gives only an approximate 2.5-hour lockdown duration, no definitive start/end timestamps or count of affected patients. Discovery is a candidate pending production dedupe. No evidence that all U.S. and territory access changes were covered.
coverage_notes.controls: Exactly one append-only JSON heartbeat to ops/watch-ledger only. No approval, public publication, task schedule change or disabling.
